title: Field Notes App
subtitle: Interface design for a research note-taking tool
description: A calm, focused interface for researchers capturing notes and observations in the field.
problem: The existing tool buried capture behind menus, slowing researchers down at the moment that mattered.
process: Mapped capture flows, designed a fast entry pattern, and built a component library for handoff.
solution: A capture-first interface with a tidy component system that engineering could ship quickly.
